label: At least as much degree in a total cause, from the strict comparative and calibration
meaning: MORE_2 side of the comparison. If the total cause c is x itself, deg r x ≤ deg r x. If not, the strict comparative makes c more r than x (MORE_1), and the open calibration STMT MoreInExceedsDegree (98755509) turns that into deg r x < deg r c, hence ≤. So the Aristotelian strict comparative, which applies to every distinct cause, strengthens to the Cartesian non-strict comparative for total causes only through the explicit MORE_1-to-degree calibration. Premises other than excluded middle stay open.
